_comment: Generated by tools/sync-golem-fx-manifest.py from golem-fx (plugin.rs + gfx-bench manifest). Do not edit. Keyed by VST3 class id (hex), as in effects-golem-engine.json. Ranges are plain and linear; `n` = option count of an enum. Read by golem_rig.lua (golem-fx under REAPER).

wah.name: Sensitivity
wah.help: Envelope window: higher = reacts to softer playing

type.name: Type
type.help: Default Wah: golem's autowah block played GxAutoWah, an envelope-driven Cry Baby; presets keep that sound

poles.name: Poles
poles.help: Filter slope: 2 poles = vocal, 4 poles = deeper, synth-like

direction.name: Direction
direction.help: Up = louder notes sweep upward; Down = they sweep downward

peak.name: Peak
peak.help: Resonance of the filter: higher = a sharper, more vocal peak

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: How fast the sweep follows a picked note

release.name: Release
release.help: How fast the sweep falls back after the note

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level against the dry signal (100 % = filter only)

level.name: Level
level.help: Check plain ↔ normalized on REAPER (negative minimum)

source.name: Source
source.help: What moves the filter: playing dynamics, an LFO, sample and hold, or both

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the LFO or sample-and-hold source

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the LFO to the host tempo; Off = the Rate control

polarity.name: Polarity
polarity.help: Fixes a phase problem between two lanes

profile.name: Profile
profile.help: Picks the voicing: anchors of every group, internal scale of Depth and Warmth

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Voice topology and its reference settings

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Peak-to-peak swing of the delay (catalogue chorus.depth: 1 – 8 ms, same meaning)

warmth.name: Warmth
warmth.help: Colour macro: wet low-pass, input saturation, BBD bandwidth and noise, in the profile's proportions

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level, dry at unity — the catalogue's law (golem forces Calf's dry to 1.0); 1.0 = wet as loud as dry (a CE-2's 50 / 50)

xover_freq.name: Crossover Freq
xover_freq.help: Below this frequency: dry signal, summed to mono

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Soft saturation of the input stage (wet only)

bbd_chip.name: BBD Chip
bbd_chip.help: Stage count: sets the clock frequency and so the aliasing

bbd_bw.name: BBD Bandwidth
bbd_bw.help: Cut-off of the anti-aliasing and reconstruction filters

emphasis.name: Emphasis
emphasis.help: BBD pre-emphasis before the line and matching de-emphasis after (CE-2: ≈ +15 dB treble shelf); lowers hiss, shapes the BBD's distortion

compander.name: Compander
compander.help: NE570-style compression/expansion (Dimension D): pumping, breathing noise

noise.name: Noise
noise.help: Hiss and clock bleed (BBD), tape hiss (Tape)

mod_custom.name: Modulation Custom
mod_custom.help: Off = follows the profile and the mode

delay_base.name: Base Delay
delay_base.help: Centre delay the modulation swings around

lfo_shape.name: LFO Shape
lfo_shape.help: Triangle is RC-smoothed like the CE-2's (no corner in pitch); Rounded = softer; Random = smoothed random; Log = Strymon "dBucket"-style log LFO

voices.name: Voices
voices.help: Used by Ensemble and Doubler; fixed by the other modes

voice_spread.name: Voice Spread
voice_spread.help: LFO phase offset between successive voices

imperfection.name: Imperfection
imperfection.help: Analogue tolerances: phase and amplitude errors between voices, curved control voltage (string ensembles)

detune_lock.name: Detune Lock
detune_lock.help: Holds the peak pitch deviation constant when Rate changes (depth shrinks as rate rises)

drift.name: Drift
drift.help: Slow random detuning of rate and depth between voices ("human")

crossmix.name: Cross-Mix
crossmix.help: L/R cross-mix of the complementary voices (Dimension mode)

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.help: Feedback; above ~30 % it drifts towards a flanger

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the LFO to the host tempo

env_depth.name: Env → Depth
env_depth.help: Playing harder adds (+) or removes (−) depth

env_mix.name: Env → Mix
env_mix.help: Playing harder raises (+) or ducks (−) the wet: chords stay clear on the attack, the chorus blooms on the sustain

stereo_phase.name: Stereo Phase
stereo_phase.help: LFO offset between left and right

mono_safe.name: Mono Safe
mono_safe.help: Complementary voices built so that the mono sum does not hollow out

wet_lpf.name: Wet High Cut
wet_lpf.help: Low-pass on the wet; Warmth moves it around this anchor

mix_law.name: Mix Law
mix_law.help: Add = dry at unity + wet × mix (catalogue); Crossfade = (1 − mix) dry + mix wet (1.0 = vibrato); Equal Power = constant level

level_comp.name: Level Comp
level_comp.help: Static gain computed from mix, the law and the voice count (never from the signal: nothing pumps), so on / off sounds equally loud

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Level above which the compressor starts to reduce gain

ratio.name: Ratio
ratio.help: How much the level above the threshold is reduced (30:1 ≈ limiting)

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: How fast gain reduction sets in once the level exceeds the threshold

release.name: Release
release.help: With auto_release: the fast stage, the slow one follows

character.name: Character
character.help: The compressor's voicing: clean, bus glue, FET, opto or pedal

knee.name: Knee
knee.help: Quadratic soft knee in dB, the same in every character

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Parallel compression; the dry runs through the same oversampling path when it is active, so the blend never combs

link.name: Stereo Link
link.help: Stereo layout: 100 = one gain for both channels

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Relative: band − full band; Absolute: band level

freq.name: Frequency
freq.help: Start of the detection band; corner of the shelf / centre of the bell

listen.name: Listen
listen.help: Solo of what the detector hears

detect.name: Detection
detect.help: Absolute = the JSFX's behaviour, the default so golem presets keep their meaning (rack session's advice); Relative = level-independent

shape.name: Shape
shape.help: How the sibilance is cut: high shelf, narrow bell or wide band

focus.name: Focus
focus.help: Vocal adds the zero-crossing confidence weight; Allround = pure high-frequency limiter (guitar de-harsh, cymbals)

ratio.name: Ratio
ratio.help: The JSFX's fixed ratio, now a parameter

time.name: Time
time.help: Note value at the host tempo (fallback 120 BPM); Free = time_ms

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level, dry at unity: linear wet gain = mix / 100 (golem's pct_db law, kept)

model.name: Model
model.help: The delay medium: digital, tape, bucket-brigade or lo-fi

low_cut.name: Low Cut
low_cut.help: In the loop: each repeat thinner

high_cut.name: High Cut
high_cut.help: In the loop, on top of the model's own roll-off: each repeat darker

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Extra saturation into the loop, on top of the model's own (Echoplex preamp idea)

mod.name: Modulation
mod.help: 50 % = the model's own wow / flutter / chorus; 0 = none; 100 = exaggerated

diffusion.name: Diffusion
diffusion.help: Allpass smear in the loop: repeats blur into a wash (ambient, EchoBoy / Valhalla)

taps.name: Taps
taps.help: Extra playback taps before the feedback point

direction.name: Direction
direction.help: Reverse: each repeat plays backwards, in windows of one delay time, crossfaded at the seams

loop_pitch.name: Loop Pitch
loop_pitch.help: A pitch shifter in the loop: each repeat climbs or falls (crystal delays at +12, shimmer delay at +7 / +12, detuned repeats at ±0.1)

loop_shift.name: Loop Freq Shift
loop_shift.help: A frequency shifter in the loop (±50 Hz, log): repeats drift inharmonically (Valhalla "Ghost"); small values = barber-pole phasing echoes

age.name: Age
age.help: Wear of the medium, per model: Tape = more wow, dropouts, crinkle, treble loss; BBD = more clock noise and compander pumping; Lo-Fi = lower rate and bits;…

swell.name: Swell
swell.help: Auto volume swell into the delay: pick attacks removed from the repeats (pad delays)

sweep.name: Loop Filter Sweep
sweep.help: A slow LFO on the loop's band-pass: each repeat filtered differently (Timeline "Filter")

duck_thresh.name: Duck Threshold
duck_thresh.help: Playing level above which the repeats duck

duck_release.name: Duck Release
duck_release.help: How fast the repeats bloom back

ratio.name: Dual Ratio
ratio.help: Right delay time as a multiple of the left one (Dual stereo mode)

width.name: Width
width.help: Stereo width of the repeats (the dry stays as it is)

hold.name: Hold
hold.help: Freeze: input muted, loop gain 1, saturation bypassed

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: Bypass switch that lets the repeats ring out when Trails is on

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: When bypassed, let the repeats already in the loop fade out naturally

detune.name: Detune
detune.help: 0 … ± 25 cents (to check against GxDetune's range in its source)

voices.name: Voices
voices.help: 2 = one up, one down (± detune), panned when stereo

ceiling.name: Ceiling
ceiling.help: Clip threshold and driven output level

voice.name: Voice
voice.help: The clipping circuit: overdrive, distortion, fuzz or golem's legacy curve

tight.name: Tight
tight.help: Extra pre-clip high-pass on top of the voice's own (metal: 150 – 300 Hz)

asym.name: Asymmetry
asym.help: Bias into the shaper (even harmonics, sputter), DC-blocked after

sag.name: Sag
sag.help: Hard hits lower the gain and move the bias

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Below it: clean only (a bass keeps its fundamental)

gain.name: Gain
gain.help: The drive pot (audio taper): clean mid boost at the bottom, a mid-range push above ~40 %

tone_stack.name: Tone
tone_stack.help: The 808 tone network: darkest at 0, the mid hump at half, presence above

level.name: Level
level.help: Output level; 0 dB = the hardware level pot fully up

headroom.name: Headroom
headroom.help: Clip knee relative to the MOSFET pair: −13 dB ≈ a Tube Screamer's diodes

asym.name: Asymmetry
asym.help: Lowers the negative knee (up to −50 %): an unmatched pair, even harmonics

tight.name: Tight
tight.help: Extra high-pass in the gain leg, on top of the 720 Hz; bypassed at 20 Hz

input.name: Input
input.help: Input trim, for a source hotter or weaker than a pickup at 0 dBFS = 1 V

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Below it: clean, so a bass keeps its fundamental

lowcut.name: Low Cut
lowcut.help: High-pass filter: removes the lows below this frequency

midgain.name: Mid Gain
midgain.help: Boost or cut of the mid bell

midfreq.name: Mid Freq
midfreq.help: Bell frequency (an EXP sweep = a fixed wah)

midprop.name: Proportional Q
midprop.help: 0 = constant Q; 100 = API-like narrowing with gain

mid2gain.name: Mid 2 Gain
mid2gain.help: Second bell: a guitarist's commonest move is two at once (cut the mud, lift the presence)

mid2freq.name: Mid 2 Freq
mid2freq.help: Centre frequency of the second mid band

mid2q.name: Mid 2 Q
mid2q.help: Same proportional-Q amount as the first bell

highfreq.name: High Freq
highfreq.help: High shelf corner (ReaEQ's band 4 value to read on the bench)

airfreq.name: Air Freq
airfreq.help: Corner frequency of the air shelf

highcut.name: High Cut
highcut.help: Low-pass, 12 dB / oct, matched (no forced zero at Nyquist)

harsh_freq.name: De-harsh Freq
harsh_freq.help: Centre of the band the de-harsher watches and tames

harsh_thresh.name: De-harsh Threshold
harsh_thresh.help: Band level relative to the full band

harsh_range.name: De-harsh Range
harsh_range.help: Maximum cut the de-harsher may apply

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the sweep (when Sync is Off)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: The flanger voicing: classic pedals, tape through-zero, barber-pole or pedal-controlled

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Exponential span between manual and length

fb_polarity.name: Feedback Polarity
fb_polarity.help: Sign of the feedback: + = metallic peaks, − = hollow notches

shape.name: LFO Shape
shape.help: Mode = the mode's own shape; Random = smoothed S&H, fixed seed

sweep_src.name: Sweep Source
sweep_src.help: What sweeps the delay: the LFO, playing dynamics, the Manual control, or LFO and dynamics

env_sens.name: Envelope Sensitivity
env_sens.help: Level at which playing dynamics start to move the sweep

env_att.name: Envelope Attack
env_att.help: How fast the envelope follows a louder note

env_rel.name: Envelope Release
env_rel.help: How fast the envelope falls back after the note

stereo_phase.name: Stereo Phase
stereo_phase.help: LFO offset between left and right (180° = opposite sweeps)

fb_hpf.name: Loop Low Cut
fb_hpf.help: High-pass in the feedback loop: keeps the lows from building up

fb_lpf.name: Loop High Cut
fb_lpf.help: Low-pass in the feedback loop: softens the resonance

slot.name: Slot
slot.help: Identifies the probe in its messages

thresh.name: Silence Threshold
thresh.help: Envelope level under which the signal counts as silent

port.name: Port
port.help: UDP port; check-scene-gap.py binds it (never 9000, the bridge's REAPER feedback port, nor 3819, Ardour's surface)

tone.name: Test Tone
tone.help: Generator mode: output = tone, input discarded

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Opening level, peak, after the sidechain filters

hold.name: Hold
hold.help: Stays open this long after the envelope falls below the close threshold

release.name: Release
release.help: Time from open to range, linear in dB

lpf.name: Sidechain High Cut
lpf.help: Butterworth low-pass on detection; ≥ 20 kHz = off

follow.name: Follow Decay
follow.help: Release adapts to how the note ended (0.25× – 4×)

damp.name: Tail Damp
damp.help: Highs close before the level (hiss under decaying notes)

hum.name: Hum Filter
hum.help: Notches mains hum out of detection

listen.name: Listen
listen.help: Outputs the filtered sidechain, for setting hpf / lpf / hum

shift.name: Interval
shift.help: Interval of the main double (−12 = one octave below)

formant.name: Formant
formant.help: The double's timbre: 0 = the voice's own, below = darker and bigger, above = lighter

voice1.name: Double Level
voice1.help: Level of the main double; 0 dB = as loud (RMS) as the dry voice; −6 dB = the *Emergence* preset

pan.name: Voice 2 Pan
pan.help: Equal-power position of voice 2 (voice 1 stays centred)

fine.name: Fine
fine.help: Detunes both doubles: with shift 0, a unison double

humanize.name: Humanize
humanize.help: Slow seeded drift of the doubles' pitch (±8 ct) and timing (±10 ms): a sung double rather than a coherent one

formant_link.name: Formant Follows Interval
formant_link.help: On: formants move with the interval; formant becomes an offset

glide.name: Glide
glide.help: Slows an interval change (scene), on top of the 1 st / ms slew

sens.name: Sensitivity
sens.help: Voicing thresholds: higher follows rougher notes

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Level gate: under it the doubles close (stage bleed between phrases)

register.name: Register
register.help: The voice's range; sets detection and the worst-case delay

hpf.name: Low Cut
hpf.help: High-pass on the doubles: an octave below a low male voice sits near 70 Hz, so the default stays under it

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: How far the signal drops when cut (100 % = silence)

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Note value of the stutter at the host tempo; Free = the Rate control

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.help: What starts the stutter: engaging the pedal, each pick attack, or the beat

sens.name: Sensitivity
sens.help: Sensitivity of the pick detector (Trigger = Pick)

smooth.name: Smooth
smooth.help: Edge crossfade, clamped to the segment; 0 = hard cut

shape.name: Shape
shape.help: Envelope of each cut: hard gate or a smoother waveform

swing.name: Swing
swing.help: Delays every other step for a shuffled rhythm

offset.name: Offset
offset.help: Grid shift, in fractions of a step

kill.name: Kill
kill.help: Momentary: hold to mute (with the edge crossfade)

restart.name: Restart
restart.help: Each off → on edge restarts the pattern

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.help: Maximum output sample level, no makeup

release.name: Release
release.help: With auto_release: scales the adaptive release

gain.name: Input Gain
gain.help: Drive into the limiter (x42's hidden input gain)

style.name: Style
style.help: How peaks are held: clean, punchy (faster release) or clip (soft clipping)

clip.name: Clip Softness
clip.help: 0 = hard (ADAA); 100 = soft from 6 dB under the threshold

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: RMS level of the key under which the expansion starts (a sine reads 3 dB below its peak)

hold.name: Hold
hold.help: Keeps the gate open this long through short pauses before it fades

release.name: Release
release.help: Shortest fade from open to fully closed; 0 = the detector alone (the original Zuul)

ratio.name: Ratio
ratio.help: Expansion slope under the threshold: 2.8 = the Zuul; 10 ≈ a hard gate

smooth.name: Smoothing
smooth.help: Slow time constant of the detector; the fast one is 13 times shorter

adaptive.name: Adaptive
adaptive.help: The circuit's timing: a fall beyond 6.5 dB switches to the fast time constant

hpf.name: Key Low Cut
hpf.help: Extra high-pass on the key, on top of the fixed 32 Hz: ignores low-string thump

lpf.name: Key High Cut
lpf.help: Low-pass on the key: ignores pick noise and single-coil hiss

source.name: Detector Source
source.help: Key = the auxiliary input; Main until a key signal has been seen

listen.name: Listen
listen.help: Outputs the filtered key, for setting hpf and lpf

octave1.name: Octave -1
octave1.help: Level of the voice one octave below

octave2.name: Octave -2
octave2.help: Level of the voice two octaves below

octave_up.name: Octave +1
octave_up.help: Level of the voice one octave above

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Tracking engine and character: vintage analog, clean, synth-like or polyphonic

instrument.name: Instrument
instrument.help: Input filter (800 / 300 Hz) and trigger time constants

sub_tone.name: Sub Tone
sub_tone.help: Low-pass on −1 oct; −2 oct follows at ~0.45×

up_tone.name: Up Tone
up_tone.help: Low-pass on the octave-up voice: tames its harshness

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.help: Hysteresis and gate relative to the envelope

glide.name: Glide
glide.help: Pitch glide between notes, for a synth-like octave

range.name: Range
range.help: Poly: only notes below this get octaved

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the sweep (when Sync is Off)

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.help: Resonance of the stages (closer to 0 dB = more pronounced)

model.name: Model
model.help: The phaser voicing: classic pedals, Uni-Vibe-style, dual or barber-pole

fb_polarity.name: Feedback Polarity
fb_polarity.help: Sign of the feedback: + = sharper peaks, − = hollow notches

manual.name: Manual
manual.help: Sweep position between low and high; the EXP target

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: How much of the frequency range the sweep covers

skew.name: Skew
skew.help: Tilts the LFO so the sweep rises and falls at different speeds (50 % = symmetric)

sweep_src.name: Sweep Source
sweep_src.help: What sweeps the stages: the LFO, playing dynamics, the Manual control, or LFO and dynamics

env_sens.name: Envelope Sensitivity
env_sens.help: How strongly playing dynamics move the sweep

env_att.name: Envelope Attack
env_att.help: How fast the envelope follows a louder note

env_rel.name: Envelope Release
env_rel.help: How fast the envelope falls back after the note

color.name: Color
color.help: 50 % = the model's own nonlinearity and mismatch (on Stone: its Color switch above 50 %); 0 = ideal

lfo2.name: Second LFO
lfo2.help: Bi-Phase: phaser B follows A, mirrors it, or runs on rate2

routing.name: Routing
routing.help: Bi-Phase: A → B, or A left / B right

lamp_lag.name: Lamp Lag
lamp_lag.help: Response time of the Vibe model's lamp: smoother sweep as it rises

shift.name: Shift
shift.help: Smoothed in semitones (≈ 10 ms one-pole + slew limit), converted per sample

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Equal-power dry / wet; the dry is delayed by the reported latency so the mix stays coherent

engine.name: Engine
engine.help: Whammy: single notes, pitch-synchronous splices, 12 ms

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.help: Poly synthesis window: Fast = 6.6 ms (tighter, a partial ~0.5 dB less on its target); Stable = 10 ms

glide.name: Glide
glide.help: Time for shift to reach a new value (heel-to-toe dives)

voice2.name: Voice 2 Level
voice2.help: Level of the second pitch voice

fine.name: Fine
fine.help: Fine tuning of voice 1 (detuned doubles, tuning to a recording)

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.help: Scale: shift and shift2 become scale steps above the played note (see below); glide is not used

key.name: Key
key.help: golem knows the song's key and can set it per song

shift.name: Shift
shift.help: Smoothed in semitones (≈ 10 ms one-pole + slew limit), converted per sample

search.name: Splice Search
search.help: WSOLA-style splice point (H3000 "deglitch"); on adds a fixed lookahead

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level, dry at unity (catalogue law)

decay.name: Decay
decay.help: Time the tail takes to fall by 60 dB in the mid band

size.name: Size
size.help: Size of the room: longer early reflections and a bigger tail

predelay.name: Predelay
predelay.help: golem pins it at insert for blocks that do not expose it (hall: 15 ms, room: 5 ms)

hicut.name: High Cut
hicut.help: Damping (RT60 halves there) + a gentle output low-pass

algo.name: Algorithm
algo.help: Pinned by golem per block (the first three are today's blocks)

bass_xover.name: Bass Crossover
bass_xover.help: Frequency below which Bass Mult scales the decay

mod.name: Modulation
mod.help: 50 % = the algorithm's own depth; 0 = static (may ring); 100 = lush, towards chorus

diffusion.name: Diffusion
diffusion.help: How quickly the echoes blur into a smooth tail

early.name: Early Reflections
early.help: 50 % = the algorithm's own level; ignored on Plate

width.name: Width
width.help: Stereo width of the tail (above 100 % = wider than the room)

era.name: Era
era.help: The converter and the modulation of the period (VintageVerb's "Color"): the tail runs at a reduced internal rate behind 4-pole converters

mod_rate.name: Modulation Rate
mod_rate.help: 50 % = the algorithm's own (Lexicon "spin"); mod is the depth ("wander")

high_mult.name: High Decay
high_mult.help: High-band RT60 ratio above hicut / 2: with bass_mult, a three-band decay

wet_low.name: Wet Low Shelf
wet_low.help: ±12 dB at 200 Hz on the wet

wet_high.name: Wet High Shelf
wet_high.help: ±12 dB at 4 kHz on the wet: tone of the reverb without changing its decay

swell.name: Swell
swell.help: Auto volume swell into the reverb: the pick attack is removed from the wet (pad / violin effect)

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Saturation into the tank; on Spring = dwell

springs.name: Springs
springs.help: Number of springs in the Spring algorithm

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Predelay (and Gated / Reverse length) as a note value

shimmer.name: Shimmer
shimmer.help: Share of the tail fed back through a pitch shifter (gfx-shimmer's regeneration insert, one voice): each pass climbs by shimmer_pitch

duck.name: Ducking
duck.help: How much the tail drops while you play

duck_release.name: Duck Release
duck_release.help: How fast the tail comes back once you stop

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.help: Freeze = the tail holds, new notes stay out; Infinite = the tail holds and new notes add to it

kill_dry.name: Kill Dry
kill_dry.help: Mutes the direct signal, for parallel routing

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: Bypass switch that lets the tail ring out when Trails is on

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: When bypassed, let the tail already in the room decay naturally

speed.name: Speed
speed.help: The footswitch; the ramp is the plugin's, never smoothed by the host

mic.name: Mic Distance
mic.help: Close = dry, aggressive, more AM; far = more reflections

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Doppler and AM together (100 % ≈ 1.5 × real geometry)

cabinet.name: Cabinet
cabinet.help: The rotary cabinet model: speaker sizes, horn and drum voicing

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Tube preamp drive before the speakers

balance.name: Horn / Drum
balance.help: Level between the horn (treble) and the drum (bass)

horn_accel.name: Horn Accel
horn_accel.help: Time the horn takes to speed up to Fast

horn_decel.name: Horn Decel
horn_decel.help: Time the horn takes to slow down from Fast to Slow

drum_accel.name: Drum Accel
drum_accel.help: Time the heavier drum takes to speed up to Fast

drum_decel.name: Drum Decel
drum_decel.help: Time the drum takes to slow down from Fast to Slow

counter.name: Counter-rotate
counter.help: Horn and drum in opposite directions

level.name: Level
level.help: Check plain ↔ normalized on REAPER (negative minimum)

grind.name: Grind
grind.help: The level pot: boost at the network's plateau

voice.name: Voice
voice.help: The shunt arm: Focused (2.7 kΩ) cuts more bass and boosts more; Full (11.8 kΩ) is ≈ 4.6 dB lower at the plateau

bright.name: Bright
bright.help: High shelf at 3 kHz, on top of the network

decay.name: Decay
decay.help: Time the tail takes to fall by 60 dB in the mid band

shimmer.name: Shimmer
shimmer.help: Share of shifted signal in the loop

pitch2.name: Pitch 2
pitch2.help: Interval of the second pitch voice

voice2.name: Voice 2 Level
voice2.help: Level of the second pitch voice

detune.name: Detune
detune.help: Detunes the two sides apart for a wider, chorused shimmer

size.name: Size
size.help: Scale of the reverb tank: bigger = slower, wider space

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.help: Diffusion; mid values fade in slowly

moddepth.name: Modulation
moddepth.help: Low by default: the shifter already modulates

space.name: Space
space.help: Which gfx-reverb tail carries the shimmer: Cloud = the biggest and slowest (ValhallaShimmer's large modes), Plate = tight and bright

swell.name: Swell
swell.help: Auto volume swell into the reverb: no pick attack in the pad (Mercury7)

voice_pan.name: Voice Spread
voice_pan.help: Voice 1 towards the left, voice 2 towards the right

bass_mult.name: Bass Decay
bass_mult.help: Low-frequency decay relative to the mid band

glide.name: Pitch Glide
glide.help: Time for pitch / pitch2 to reach a new value: scene changes sweep instead of jumping

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.help: Freeze = the pad holds, the climb stops (shifter out of the loop), new notes stay out; Infinite = the pad holds and new notes add to it

kill_dry.name: Kill Dry
kill_dry.help: Mutes the direct signal, for a parallel lane

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: When bypassed, let the tail decay naturally

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: Bypass switch that lets the tail ring out when Trails is on

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the volume modulation (when Sync is Off)

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Trough gain = 1 − depth; lamp drive in Optical / Neon

model.name: Model
model.help: The tremolo circuit: clean VCA, valve bias, optical cell, neon or harmonic (two bands in opposition)

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the rate to the host tempo; Off = the Rate control

xover.name: Crossover
xover.help: Split frequency of the Harmonic model's two bands

level.name: Level
level.help: Makeup (a tremolo lowers the average level)

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: 0 – 100 cents (Clean, BBD); stage swing (Varistor, Vibe); V1 → V3 (Scanner)

speed.name: Speed
speed.help: Speed of the pitch modulation (when Sync is Off)

model.name: Model
model.help: The vibrato circuit: clean delay, BBD, varistor, Uni-Vibe-style or organ scanner

shape.name: Shape
shape.help: Random = smoothed, fixed seed, with LFO wobble

tone.name: Tone
tone.help: Low-pass after the vibrato: darker as it rises

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the speed to the host tempo; Off = the Speed control

level.name: Level
level.help: Output; GxTubeVibrato plays ~6.6 dB louder than unity (golem-rack, pink noise): golem can pin it at insert for preset continuity

model.name: Model
model.help: The wah circuit whose sweep, Q and voicing are played

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level against the dry signal (100 % = wah only)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Manual = the pedal sweeps; auto = the envelope sweeps; alien = both

taper.name: Taper
taper.help: How the pedal travel maps onto the sweep; Model = the circuit's own pot

toe.name: Toe
toe.help: Where the sweep ends at toe down (percent of the full range)

auto_engage.name: Auto Engage
auto_engage.help: Switches the wah on when the pedal moves, off when it rests at heel

engage_wait.name: Engage Wait
engage_wait.help: How long the pedal must rest at heel before the wah switches off

env_sens.name: Envelope Sensitivity
env_sens.help: How strongly playing dynamics move the sweep (auto and alien modes)

env_att.name: Envelope Attack
env_att.help: How fast the envelope follows a louder note

env_rel.name: Envelope Release
env_rel.help: How fast the envelope falls back after the note
